temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth tells Keith she is not upset with him; her short responses were due to personal stuff, and she apologizes for seeming short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth may be upset with him because of an unknown misunderstanding or mistake he made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth's explanation disconfirms his belief that he caused her curtness; he learns it is due to her personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal issues.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be understanding of her situation and consider how to support her without taking her curtness personally.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Keith offers support and suggests a coffee break; Elizabeth thanks him and accepts the coffee break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress, not anger at Keith, and Keith feels sympathetic toward her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth's acceptance confirms she welcomes his support and is open to spending time with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth appreciates his offer and is willing to take a coffee break; his support is welcome.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Use the coffee break to listen and offer support for whatever she is going through.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth shares more about her severe stresses. Keith suggests professional help; Elizabeth says she has thought about it but is unsure and hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is under serious personal stress; Keith believes professional help might benefit her, but he is concerned about suggesting it without offending her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth does not reject professional help outright, but she is hesitant and unsure, so the topic is sensitive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Professional help could still be beneficial, but Elizabeth is ambivalent and not ready to commit; Keith should be careful and supportive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Support Elizabeth without pushing; respect her hesitation about seeking professional help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after the professional-help suggestion. Keith apologizes if he overstepped; Elizabeth says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes his suggestion of professional help may have embarrassed Elizabeth and that he may have overstepped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth's reassurance changes his belief: she says he did not overstep and appreciates his concern, though she is still processing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He did not offend or embarrass her, but the topic is still weighing on her; his support is valued.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful and anxious initially, then relieved but still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Elizabeth of his support and avoid pressuring her further.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth says she appreciates Keith's concern and that she feels better knowing she has his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth values his support and feels more comfortable around him after their last conversation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, confirmed. Elizabeth's explicit thanks and statement that she feels better confirm she values his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support, feels better knowing she has it, and their relationship is supportive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the supportive relationship and remain available for chats or breaks when she needs him.
